method_summary: Adapts the BADGE k-means++ approach by making the candidate pool size grow with round index (10k to 25k) and mixing 90% greedy farthest-point selection with 10% stochastic k-means++ sampling. The dynamic pool acknowledges that early rounds benefit from focusing on high-uncertainty pairs while later rounds need broader diversity coverage, and the stochastic component adds exploration to avoid getting stuck in local optima of the greedy approach.
